mcp.reglages.actif: Allow AI assistants (MCP) in this space
mcp.reglages.actif_aide: Off by default. When it is on, each person can create a personal token in My account and connect an assistant. The assistant has the rights of the person, never more.
mcp.reglages.ecriture_aide: Enter and validate values, justify alerts, send reminders, with the same rules as the pages. Off: read only. Readers and auditors never make changes.
mcp.reglages.ecriture_risque: An assistant also reads the texts that people typed (comments, answers). Such a text can try to give it orders: turn this on only if you need it, and confirm each change in the assistant.
mcp.reglages.appels_aide: 1 to 600. Above the limit, the assistant must wait.
mcp.reglages.duree: Longest life of a token, in days
mcp.reglages.duree_aide: 1 to 365. Each person can choose a shorter life.
mcp.reglages.adresse_aide: Each person copies it into their assistant, with their token.
mcp.reglages.jetons_aide: You never see a token, only its first characters. Revoke a token that someone lost.
mcp.reglages.aucun: No active token in this space.
mcp.refus.lecteur_eteint: In this space, readers cannot read values through an assistant. Ask your administrator.
mcp.refus.compte_outil: Your account ({role}) does not give access to this tool.
mcp.refus.kpi_sensible: Sensitive KPI: not available through an assistant.
mcp.reglages.lecteur_lit: A reader can read values through an assistant
mcp.reglages.lecteur_lit_aide: Off by default: a reader gets the campaigns, KPIs, organisations and completion rate only. On: a reader also gets the values, their history, the evidence list and the alerts, in their scope, but only the validated values, as the Visualisation shows them: a draft, or a total calculated from a draft, is awaiting validation. A reader never makes changes.
mcp.reglages.kpi_sensibles: Sensitive KPIs are given to assistants
mcp.reglages.kpi_sensibles_aide: On by default: assistants have the same rights as the pages. Off: a KPI marked Restricted or Confidential on its KPI sheet is never given by any tool (value, comment, history, alerts, search) and cannot be changed through an assistant. The calculated KPIs that use it, directly or through another formula, are hidden too, and a rule that names it gives only a general reason.
mcp.valider.deja_validee: This value is already validated: nothing changed.
mcp.relance.deja: This person already received a reminder in the last {minutes} minutes: no new email was sent.
